title: AIR CONDITIONING-RADIATOR OUTLET HOSES
summary: LS5 (454) cars with air conditioning (C60): the lower radiator hose is a three-piece assembly, an outlet hose from the water pump inlet, a metal connecting tube, and a short outlet hose to the radiator outlet. The two hose-to-tube joints use clamps [4]; the ends at the water pump and radiator use production clamps.

parts.name: HOSE ASM-OUTLET
parts.name_expanded: Hose assembly - outlet (water pump end of lower radiator hose)

parts.name: HOSE-OUTLET
parts.name_expanded: Hose - outlet (radiator end of lower radiator hose)

fastening.note: Hose [1] and hose [3] each slip over an end of tube [2] and are tightened with one clamp [4] each (2 clamps).
Upper end of hose [1] goes on the water pump inlet neck, held by a production clamp (no callout).
Lower end of hose [3] goes on the radiator outlet, held by a production clamp (no callout).

notes_internal: Model box reads "19000 (LS5)"; page models kept as 19000, LS5 recorded in options.
The upper production clamp is the screw-type clamp drawn at the water pump inlet; inlet identity read from the drawing (pump housing with pulley).
